
Inspect and extract saved tools/cpu records

$ conda-presto --parse -f conda.lock > saved.json

$ jq '{environments, selected}' saved.json
{
  "environments": [
    {
      "name": "default",
      "platforms": {
        "cpu": "linux-64",
        "gpu": "linux-64"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "platforms": {
        "cpu": "linux-64",
        "gpu": "linux-64"
      }
    }
  ],
  "selected": []
}

$ conda-presto --export -f conda.lock -e tools -p cpu --format conda-workspaces-lock-v1 > extracted/conda.lock

$ conda-presto --parse -f extracted/conda.lock > extracted.json

$ jq .environments extracted.json
[
  {
    "name": "tools",
    "platforms": {
      "cpu": "linux-64"
    }
  }
]

Render exact URLs and a normalized declaration

$ conda-presto --export -f conda.lock -e tools -p cpu --format explicit > explicit.txt

$ cat explicit.txt
# This file may be used to create an environment using:
# $ conda create --name <env> --file <this file>
# platform: linux-64
# created-by: conda 26.5.3
@EXPLICIT
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/linux-64/libzlib-1.3.2-h25fd6f3_3.conda
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/linux-64/zlib-1.3.2-h25fd6f3_3.conda
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/linux-64/zstd-1.5.7-hb78ec9c_7.conda
$ conda-presto --export -f conda.lock -e tools -p cpu --format conda-toml > normalized.toml

$ head -n 6 normalized.toml
[workspace]
name = "tools"
channels = ["conda-forge"]
platforms = ["linux-64"]

[dependencies]

Convert a generic lock and generate an SBOM from saved records

$ conda-presto --export -f conda-lock.yml -p linux-64 --format pixi-lock-v6 > pixi.lock

$ conda-presto --export -f conda.lock -e tools -p cpu --manifest conda.toml --format cyclonedx-json-v1.7 > sbom.json

$ jq '{bomFormat, specVersion, packages: [.components[] | {name, version}], roots: [.metadata.component.properties[] | select(.name == "conda:environment:root-dependency-source")]}' sbom.json
{
  "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
  "specVersion": "1.7",
  "packages": [
    {
      "name": "libzlib",
      "version": "1.3.2"
    },
    {
      "name": "zlib",
      "version": "1.3.2"
    },
    {
      "name": "zstd",
      "version": "1.5.7"
    }
  ],
  "roots": [
    {
      "name": "conda:environment:root-dependency-source",
      "value": "requested-packages"
    }
  ]
}

$ python check_locks.py
Workspace extraction preserves exact records and explicit package URLs
Normalized declaration preserves saved versions, URLs and hashes
Generic lock conversion preserves package URLs and hashes
SBOM contains exact saved packages, hashes and declared zlib/zstd roots
